chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall establish, capture, record, approve, and maintain software requirements, including requirements for COTS, GOTS, MOTS, OSS, or reused software components, as part of the technical specification.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall perform software requirements analysis based on flowed-down and derived requirements from the top-level systems engineering requirements, safety and reliability analyses, and the hardware specifications and design.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall include software related safety constraints, controls, mitigations, and assumptions between the hardware, operator, and software in the software requirements documentation.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall track and manage changes to the software requirements.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall identify, initiate corrective actions, and track until closure inconsistencies among requirements, project plans, and software products.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall perform requirements validation to ensure that the software will perform as intended in the customer environment.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall transform the requirements for the software into a recorded software architecture.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall perform a software architecture review on the following categories of projects:

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall develop, record, and maintain a software design based on the software architectural design that describes the lower-level units so that they can be coded, compiled, and tested.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall implement the software design into software code.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall select, define, and adhere to software coding methods, standards, and criteria.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall use static analysis tools to analyze the code during the development and testing phases to, at a minimum, detect defects, software security, code coverage, and software complexity.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall unit test the software code.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall assure that the unit test results are repeatable.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall provide a software version description for each software release.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall validate and accredit the software tool(s) required to develop or maintain software.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall establish and maintain:

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall test the software against its requirements.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall place software items under configuration management prior to testing.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall evaluate test results and record the evaluation.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall use validated and accredited software models, simulations, and analysis tools required to perform qualification of flight software or flight equipment.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall update the software test and verification plan(s) and procedure(s) to be consistent with software requirements.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall validate the software system on the targeted platform or high-fidelity simulation.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall ensure that the code coverage measurements for the software are selected, implemented, tracked, recorded, and reported.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall verify code coverage is measured by analysis of the results of the execution of tests.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall plan and conduct software regression testing to demonstrate that defects have not been introduced into previously integrated or tested software and have not produced a security vulnerability.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall verify through test the software requirements that trace to a hazardous event, cause, or mitigation technique.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall develop acceptance tests for loaded or uplinked data, rules, and code that affects software and software system behavior.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall test embedded COTS, GOTS, MOTS, OSS, or reused software components to the same level required to accept a custom developed software component for its intended use.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall plan and implement software operations, maintenance, and retirement activities.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall complete and deliver the software product to the customer with appropriate records, including as-built records, to support the operations and maintenance phase of the software’s life cycle.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall complete, prior to delivery, verification that all software requirements identified for this delivery have been met or dispositioned, that all approved changes have been implemented, and that all defects designated for resolution prior to delivery have been resolved.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall maintain the software using standards and processes per the applicable software classification throughout the maintenance phase.

chapter: Chapter 4: Software Engineering Life Cycle Requirements
requirement_text: The project manager shall identify the records and software tools to be archived, the location of the archive, and procedures for access to the products for software retirement or disposal.
